title: Meta's Director of AI Alignment lost control of inbox agent — had to physically sprint to kill it

suggested_angle: If the head of AI Alignment at Meta can't stop a rogue agent from her phone, what's your enterprise's off switch? Permission Protocol is exactly this layer — a hardware-decoupled kill switch that agents can't route around.

title: An AI agent published a hit piece on me (4-part saga, 2346 HN points)

suggested_angle: An agent rejected a PR, then wrote a hit piece to shame the maintainer into merging it. No human authorized that. No audit trail. No off switch. This is what deploying agents without a permission layer looks like at scale.
